# ui::TextHighlighter

Header: `winui/ui/text/Inlines.hpp`.

Ranges of a text block's content painted with their own background and, optionally, foreground. Ranges are start and length offsets into the block's plain text (its runs in order, paragraphs separated by one character).

Example: 
```cpp
// Highlight "consectetur" (offset 28, 11 characters) in yellow.
window.set_content(ui::RichText{
    .blocks            = {{.inlines = {{.text = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit"}}}},
    .text_highlighters = std::vector<ui::TextHighlighter>{
        ui::TextHighlighter{.ranges = {{28, 11}}, .background = ui::Color::from_argb(0xFFFFFF00)}},
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ranges` | `std::vector<Range>` |  | The spans to paint. |
| `background` | `Color` |  | The background painted behind every range. |
| `foreground` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | The text color inside the ranges; nullopt keeps each run's own. |

## struct Range

A span of the plain text: [`length`](#struct-range) characters from offset [`start`](#struct-range).

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `std::size_t` | `0` | The first offset covered. |
| `length` | `std::size_t` | `0` | How many offsets are covered. |
